WHAT'S INSIDE • 24 heart sounds and murmurs — from normal S1/S2 to aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy, pericardial friction rub and summation gallop • A labelled waveform for every sound, with systole and diastole marked and S1, S2, A2, P2, ejection clicks, opening snaps and gallops called out where they actually occur • Half-speed playback, for murmurs that go by too fast at full speed • Compare any two sounds — a murmur against normal, or against the one you keep mistaking it for — and switch between them with one tap • Auscultation site diagrams showing where each sound is heard best • Seven sections of study notes per sound: description, etiology, pathophysiology, physical examination, diagnostic evaluation, clinical presentation and treatment • Room for your own notes on any sound QUIZ YOURSELF Choose which murmurs you want in the pool — everything, one of the built-in sets, your favorites, or a handful you pick — then choose how many questions and start. Five for a quick drill, twenty when you have time. Answer from six options, or name it yourself and score your own recall. Switch on re-asking and a murmur you miss comes back a few questions later, because that is the one you needed to hear again.
